questions.stem: 和身體上的傷相比，我們內心所承受的往往比較難被別人看見，但它一樣真實。
questions.answer: Compared with physical injuries, what we suffer inside is often less visible to others, but it is just as real.
accepted_answers: Compared to physical wounds, what we go through emotionally is often harder for others to see, but it is equally real.
In comparison with injuries to the body, what we endure in our hearts is usually less visible to other people, yet it is just as real.

questions.stem: 今年到學校輔導室尋求協助的學生人數是去年的兩倍。
questions.answer: This year, the number of students seeking help from the school's counseling office is twice as high as it was last year.
accepted_answers: The number of students seeking help at the school counseling office this year is twice as high as last year's.
The number of students seeking help from the school's counseling office this year is two times as large as last year's.

1.explanation_zh: 句首「和…相比」用 Compared with／to + 名詞（過去分詞片語，不用 Compare／Comparing）。「我們內心所承受的」沒有被修飾的名詞，用 what 名詞子句當主詞 what we suffer inside，動詞用單數 is。「比較難被別人看見」可寫 less visible to others 或 harder for others to see（hard to V 用主動不定詞）。「一樣真實」是 just as real／equally real。
1.strategy_zh: 句首「和…相比」直接用 Compared with …,；主詞是「…所…的」時改成 what 子句。
hints: 切成四段：和身體上的傷相比／我們內心所承受的／往往比較難被別人看見／但它一樣真實
標的詞彙：physical（身體的）、injury（傷）、suffer（承受、受苦）、visible（看得見的）、real（真實的）
句型框架：Compared with + N, what + S + V + is + 比較級 …, but it is just as + adj.

2.explanation_zh: 「到學校輔導室尋求協助的學生」中文修飾語在前，英文用現在分詞片語後位修飾：students seeking help from the school's counseling office（＝students who seek help …）。「人數」是 the number of + 複數名詞，動詞跟著 number 用單數 is。「是去年的兩倍」用倍數比較 twice as high as it was last year／two times as large as last year's，比較的是人數和去年的人數。
evidence: 到學校輔導室尋求協助的學生
2.strategy_zh: 「…的人數是…的 X 倍」：主詞用 the number of + N + 分詞片語，再接 is X times as + 形容詞 + as …。
hints: 切成四段：（今年到）學校輔導室／尋求協助的學生／人數／是去年的兩倍
標的詞彙：number（數目）、student（學生）、seek（尋求）、help（協助）、counsel（輔導）、twice（兩倍）
句型框架：This year, the number of + N + V-ing … is twice as + adj. + as it was last year

references: Compared with physical injuries, what we suffer inside is often less visible to others, but it is just as real.
Compared to physical wounds, what we go through emotionally is often harder for others to see, but it is equally real.
In comparison with injuries to the body, what we endure in our hearts is usually less visible to other people, yet it is just as real.

patterns.label_zh: what 名詞子句當主詞（所…的）

patterns.frame: Compared with/to + N, S + V + 比較級 …

accepted: In comparison with injuries to the body
Compared with injuries to the body

common_errors.explanation_zh: 句首的「和…相比」用過去分詞 Compared with／to；Compare 是原形動詞，會變成祈使句。
被比較的是後面的主詞，用被動意味的 Compared with，不用 Comparing。

accepted: what we endure in our hearts

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「所承受的（東西）」沒有名詞，要用 what 子句當主詞。

common_errors.right: what we suffer in our hearts
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「內心」寫 inside、emotionally 或 in our hearts；heart 前要有所有格。

parts.zh: 往往比較難被別人看見
accepted: is often less visible to others
is often harder for others to see
is usually less visible to other people
is often harder for other people to see
is often less noticeable to others

common_errors.wrong: is often more difficult to be seen by others
common_errors.right: is often harder for others to see
common_errors.explanation_zh: hard／difficult to V 的不定詞用主動（harder for others to see），不寫 to be seen。

common_errors.wrong: is often less visible than others
common_errors.right: is often less visible to others
common_errors.explanation_zh: 這裡是「對別人來說比較不明顯」，用 to others；than others 會變成和別人比較。

accepted: but it is just as real
yet it is just as real
but it is no less real

common_errors.right: but it is just as real
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「一樣…」用 just as＋形容詞或 equally＋形容詞；same 不能修飾形容詞。

common_errors.right: but it is just as real
common_errors.explanation_zh: be 動詞後面要用形容詞 real（真實的）；really 是副詞。

traps.literal_error: Compared with physical injuries, our inside bearing is often less visible …
traps.explanation_zh: 「內心所承受的」是抽象的心理痛苦，不要逐字湊名詞；用 what we suffer inside 或 emotional pain。

traps.literal_error: … is often more difficult to be seen by others …
traps.explanation_zh: hard／difficult to V 的句型裡不定詞用主動：harder for others to see；或直接用形容詞 less visible to others。

bonus.text: Unlike physical injuries, what we suffer inside often goes unnoticed by others, though it is every bit as real.
bonus.explanation_zh: unlike（不像）、go unnoticed（沒被注意到）、every bit as + 形容詞（完全一樣…）是更道地的寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「我們內心所承受的」沒有名詞中心語，英文改用 what 子句當主詞；「比較難被別人看見」不必照中文用被動，改寫成 less visible to others 或 harder for others to see。

references: This year, the number of students seeking help from the school's counseling office is twice as high as it was last year.
The number of students seeking help at the school counseling office this year is twice as high as last year's.
The number of students seeking help from the school's counseling office this year is two times as large as last year's.

patterns.label_zh: 倍數比較（twice／two times as … as）
patterns.frame: S + is + twice as + adj. + as + it was … ／ two times as + adj. + as …

patterns.label_zh: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（N + V-ing …）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 學校「輔導室」是 counseling office（或 guidance office）；consulting room 是診間。
帶受詞的分詞片語要放在名詞後面修飾。
學生是主動去尋求協助，用現在分詞 seeking；sought 會變成另一個動詞。
可數名詞的「數目」用 the number of；amount 用於不可數名詞。
the number of（…的數目）的 number 用單數，動詞也用單數 is。

accepted: is twice as high as it was last year
is twice as high as last year's
is two times as large as last year's
is twice that of last year

common_errors.wrong: is two times than last year
common_errors.right: is twice as high as last year's
common_errors.explanation_zh: 倍數比較寫 twice／X times as + 形容詞 + as，或 X times + 比較級 + than；two times than 少了形容詞。

common_errors.wrong: is twice as high as last year
common_errors.right: is twice as high as last year's
common_errors.explanation_zh: 比較的是「人數」和「去年的人數」，要寫 last year's（number）或 it was last year，不能拿人數和年份比。

traps.zh: 到學校輔導室尋求協助的學生
traps.literal_error: the number of seeking help from the school counseling office students …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語放在「學生」前面；英文要把分詞片語放在名詞後面：students seeking help from …。

traps.literal_error: … is two times than last year.
traps.explanation_zh: 倍數要和比較結構一起用：twice as high as …／two times higher than …；也要拿人數和去年的人數比。

bonus.text: This year, the school's counseling office has seen twice as many students seeking help as last year.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用「地點＋see＋人數」（某處迎來了…）是很道地的英文；twice as many + 複數名詞 + as 也是倍數比較。

1.translation: Compared with physical injuries, what we suffer inside is often harder for others to see, but it is just as real.
1.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用 Compared with；「我們內心所承受的」用 what 名詞子句當主詞；「比較難被別人看見」用 harder for others to see（主動不定詞表被動意）；「一樣真實」用 just as real。

2.translation: The number of students seeking help at the school counseling office this year is twice that of last year.
2.explanation_zh: 「…的學生人數」用 The number of students，動詞配單數 is；「尋求協助」用現在分詞片語 seeking help 修飾 students，避開「今年仍在進行」造成的時態判斷；「是去年的兩倍」用 twice that of last year，that 代替 the number（也可寫 Twice as many students ... this year as last year）。中文沒說是哪一所學校，用 the school 泛指學生所屬學校。

issues_zh: 「今年」沒有分到任何部分，第 4 部分 accepted（is twice as high as last year's 等）也不含 this year；學生漏譯「今年」時，依 4 部分評不到扣分。建議把「今年」併進第 2 或第 4 部分。另外第 1 部分「學校輔導室」、第 3 部分「人數」都很輕，主要難點集中在第 4 部分，輕重不太平均。
（說明）我用 twice that of last year（倍數＋that of），屬倍數比較且在第 4 部分 accepted 內，所以算 COMP；但 COMP 的 frame 只寫 twice／two times as … as，程式比對可能找不到。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者說用了句型 COMP，程式在譯文裡看不出來
第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：「今年」沒有分到任何部分，第 4 部分 accepted（is twice as high as last year's 等）也不含 this year；學生漏譯「今年」時，依 4 部分評不到扣分。建議把「今年」併進第 2 或第 4 部分。

1.translation: Compared with physical injuries, what we endure inside is often harder for others to see, but it is just as real.
1.explanation_zh: 「和……相比」用 Compared with；「我們內心所承受的」用名詞子句 what we endure inside，但這句的主詞也可以譯成 the pain we suffer emotionally，所以信心中等；「一樣真實」用 just as real。

2.translation: The number of students seeking help at the school counseling office this year is twice that of last year.
2.explanation_zh: 「人數」用 The number of students ... is，主詞單數；「是去年的兩倍」用倍數表達 twice that of last year；尋求協助用現在分詞片語 seeking help 修飾 students。

issues_zh: 盲譯者把「是去年的兩倍」譯成 is twice that of last year（倍數表達，但不是 twice as … as 的框架），程式也不把它認成 COMP；中文沒有逼出 twice as … as 的倍數比較。part 4 的 accepted 收了 is twice that of last year 和 has doubled since last year，等於承認不用 COMP 框架也算對，和標的句型 COMP 互相矛盾。建議把 COMP 的 frame 放寬到包含 twice that of，或從 accepted 移除不含 as … as 的寫法並讓中文引出 as many as／as high as。另外「今年」沒有被任何一個部分涵蓋（四個部分是學校輔導室、尋求協助的學生、人數、是去年的兩倍），但所有參考譯文都有 this year，少寫也能拿滿分。
